story: Where it started: backend systems and month-end reporting for a global sales platform.
impact: Where I learned how much a business depends on its reports being right at month end.

story: Added test coverage to an automotive platform and built a vehicle management system on outside vehicle data.
impact: My first live integration: vehicle data from an outside service flowing into a production system, with tests to prove it worked.

story: Looked after a bespoke CMS written in plain PHP, with no framework to lean on.
impact: Extending code with no framework to lean on, which teaches you why frameworks exist.

story: Joined as a backend developer and became lead, owning payments, data encryption and integrations like Salesforce and Twilio.
impact: Moving from developer to lead, owning payments, data encryption and third-party integrations.

story: Built features for a SaaS platform for business planning and project management.
impact: A product built around clarity and prioritisation needs features that stay simple to use.

story: Built patent and trademark renewal workflows covering more than 50 countries.
impact: One set of workflows had to handle the renewal rules of more than 50 countries without becoming 50 special cases.

story: Built an education platform with social features, from the TypeScript front end to the Laravel API.
impact: Working across the whole stack, from the TypeScript interface to the Laravel API behind it.

story: Moved lending services out of a legacy monolith into Java services, a piece at a time, using the Strangler Pattern.
impact: Evolving a business-critical platform incrementally without interrupting existing lending operations.

story: Worked on customer registration and account management for a payments platform, including Twilio verification.
impact: Onboarding is a customer’s first impression of a financial platform. It has to be secure and still feel easy.

story: Built APIs and configurable patient-data forms used across clinical research studies.
impact: One platform had to serve many clinical studies, each with its own questions and validation rules.

story: Moved a wealth management platform to PHP 8 and MySQL 8, with regression tests to keep releases safe.
impact: Reducing migration risk without sacrificing stability for the users who depended on the platform.

story: Designed supplier-agnostic APIs and event-driven workflows that connect broadband and energy sales to suppliers, on Azure.
impact: Making supplier onboarding repeatable, and keeping high-volume sales reliable and easy to change.
